name: Favourites Board
tagline: Pin the Civitai models you keep coming back to, with a note on why.

scopeJustifications.user:read:self: Shows the signed-in viewer's own username at the top of their board. Asked for only when the viewer clicks "Show my name"; the board works without it.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:read: Loads the viewer's own board (the models they pinned and their notes) from this app's per-viewer store.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:write: Saves the viewer's board when they pin or remove a model, in this app's per-viewer store.
